categories.main_business_segments: Dong Suh Companies Inc. operates primarily in four business segments: Food Business (including food ingredients and imported beverages), Manufacturing Business (packaging materials, tea products, coffee product packaging and sales), Purchasing and Export Business (creamer exports and raw material purchasing agency), and Other Business (asset leasing and logistics). The Food Business accounts for the largest revenue share, followed by Manufacturing and Purchasing/Export segments.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing technologies for producing food packaging films, including polyethylene extrusion combined with aluminum foil lamination. It also develops functional and eco-friendly packaging materials, supported by in-house R&D teams focused on packaging and tea product innovation. Production capacity is calculated based on operational efficiency, machine uptime, and yield, with significant investments in machinery and quality control systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include affiliated companies such as Dong Suh Foods, large discount retailers, online marketplaces, direct consumers, and distributors. The company serves domestic food ingredient markets, retail and wholesale beverage sectors, and exports creamer products primarily to Russia and Southeast Asia. It also supplies packaging materials and tea products to both internal affiliates and external clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within South Korea, with significant import activities from Southeast Asia and Europe. Export markets include Russia and Southeast Asian countries. The company manages international supply chains and foreign exchange risks related to USD and Euro currencies, reflecting its global sourcing and export activities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Dong Suh Companies Inc. operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It imports raw materials and food ingredients, manufactures packaging and tea products, and distributes finished goods to retailers and end consumers. It also provides purchasing agency and export services, positioning itself as a comprehensive food and packaging solutions provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes R&D in eco-friendly and functional packaging materials, including non-VOC inks and transparent nylon films for food packaging. It also focuses on developing new tea products, such as single-serve corn tea, and enhancing product quality and safety through advanced analytical technologies. R&D investments are maintained at about 0.1% of sales, supporting innovation in packaging and tea segments.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through product sales of food ingredients, imported beverages, packaging materials, tea products, and coffee packaging. Additional income comes from export sales, purchasing agency fees, and asset leasing. The company relies on both domestic sales channels (retailers, distributors, online) and international exports, with a focus on volume sales and stable pricing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces strong competition in the food and packaging industries, characterized by many small and large players. It maintains a leading market position in tea products and packaging materials through brand recognition, quality, and innovation. Its competitive strengths include stable supply chains, digital marketing integration, and eco-friendly product development, differentiating it from competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For fiscal year 2023, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately 489.7 billion KRW, a 12% decrease from the previous year, mainly due to reduced food business sales. Operating profit increased by 11.7% to 43.8 billion KRW, supported by improved product mix and cost management. The company maintains a strong financial structure with a 95.8% equity ratio and low debt ratio of 4.4%, and holds substantial liquid assets exceeding 7.3 trillion KRW.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Dong Suh Companies Inc. emphasizes reliable product quality, reasonable pricing, and continuous new product development to meet diverse consumer preferences. Its value proposition includes eco-friendly and functional packaging solutions, premium and differentiated food products, and strong customer service. The company leverages its extensive overseas supplier network and digital marketing capabilities to ensure stable supply and enhance brand value.
